query.description: §33 Tool 2 (ADR-0055 D-C): the §20 planner classifies the query and the class is recorded as provenance.planner_class; it is never a refusal. While dense is the only delivered lane it answers every class, and when the caller sent no `mode` and the class is not SEMANTIC, completeness.degradations carries LANE_SUBSTITUTED (DegradeCode::LaneSubstituted). Only an explicit `mode` naming an undelivered lane is refused, with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (see `mode`). Witness: bins/gateway/tests/mcp_gateway.rs::recall_everyday_queries_are_answered_by_dense_with_lane_substituted.

limit.description: §55.1 / §33.5 (ADR-0055 D-D): candidate depth (cand_k) and top_k come ONLY from the registered retrieval profile — crates/retrieval/src/request.rs:203 freezes that a caller may not supply top_k/cand_k. `limit` in 1..=profile top_k is accepted and only shortens the returned memory items (read-your-writes overlay items are never truncated); a value above top_k is INVALID_INPUT at bins/gateway/src/recall.rs:374-383 (operator line limit_not_profile_top_k naming both numbers). JSON Schema cannot express "at most a runtime profile value", so the field keeps its type and bounds (input validation at the trust boundary is not removed) and the gateway is the authority. Witness: bins/gateway/tests/mcp_gateway.rs::recall_with_a_consistency_token_answers_and_a_caller_chosen_limit_is_refused.

mode.description: §33 Canonical MCP Tool Details, Tool 2 (card 22): the five-value closed set is the TARGET shape; this delivery point implements the semantic lane only. Values outside x-humaux-v1-supported are refused with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE at bins/gateway/src/recall.rs:331 (ADR-0055 D-C keeps this as the only planner-related refusal; an absent `mode` lets dense answer every planner class with LANE_SUBSTITUTED) — the contract admits the lane, this deployment has no implementation (§52). The unsupported values stay in the enum on purpose: deleting them would make that guard unreachable and its refusal unobservable (§80.1). This declaration is not advisory prose: architecture-check's gate 「§33 card 22 (Tool 2 semantic lane)」 (xtask/src/architecture_check.rs::recall_v1_supported_lanes) reads x-humaux-v1-supported and requires the recall.rs guard to name exactly its complement — fault witness recall_v1_supported_lanes_faults_every_single_place_drift. The runtime authority is still the guard.

completeness_request.description: §33 Tool 2 (card 22): best_effort is the delivered behaviour; "required" is refused with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE at bins/gateway/src/recall.rs:332. Same reason as `mode`: the value stays in the enum so the refusal stays reachable. This declaration is not advisory prose: architecture-check's gate 「§33 card 22 (Tool 2 semantic lane)」 (xtask/src/architecture_check.rs::recall_v1_supported_lanes) reads x-humaux-v1-supported and requires the recall.rs guard to name exactly its complement — fault witness recall_v1_supported_lanes_faults_every_single_place_drift. The runtime authority is still the guard.

affect.description: §8.5.1 (ADR-0030 D-D): explicit structured affect query — every clause ANDed; a memory matches when one of its annotations satisfies all clauses on its read-time effective intensity. Qdrant structured-payload prefilter + PG re-check.

mood_congruence.description: §8.5.1 (ADR-0030 D-D): the reader's current mood (valence, arousal basis points). Bounded late rerank of the already-visible set by circumplex congruence — never widens or narrows it. The visible set is the first profile top_k PG-gate survivors in dense order (never all cand_k candidates, ADR-0055 D-A); `limit` shortens the reranked list afterwards. Witness: bins/gateway/tests/mcp_gateway.rs::recall_mood_rerank_permutes_only_the_visible_top_k.
